title: Moku — IG Story Ad v2 (motion): "Slow down." One circle of clay
spine: spec-type.md ("Slow down.", type-led): the highest combined judge score (craft 8.5 + ad 8 + build 8 = 24.5). Taken from it: the frame-0 hook ("S l o w" collapsing its tracking at 400 px, "down." dropping in per letter with blur), the dot popping into the counter of the "o", "Ash Vase" at 230 px and "$48" at 220 px, the full-frame terracotta "10%" field that contracts into the CTA pill, and the build method (single-source keyframes JSON with frame-exact cut pairs). The keyframes are also published as final-spec.keyframes.json next to the spec, generated and validated by final/gen-final.mjs: 93 animated layers, 182 tracks, 681 keys, every key on the 1/30 s grid except cut pairs, at most 10 keys per track.
grafts: Graphic: one terracotta circle carries every scene. It is born as the dot in the 'o', swells into the wheel disc, collapses onto the vase belly as a 96 px dot, and bursts into the image band as a circle-to-rectangle morph. Later the bowl wall blooms into the offer field, which collapses into the CTA pill.
Graphic: a concentric stacked iris (clay at 2.4, cream at 2.467, hands photo at 2.533) inside the disc, closing in reverse order as the disc collapses.
Graphic: the disc anticipates +5 %, then collapses on IN to Ø 96 at (384, 1180). A terracotta plate and then a clay plate wipe off inside the band, 2 frames apart, with 14 px blur.
Graphic: exactly three hand-keyed overshoots: the dot (1.25 → 0.95 → 1), '$48' (−18 → +5 → 0 px) and the CTA pulse at 13.2 (1.08 → 0.985 → 1).
Graphic: the brand never leaves the screen. It flips colour once (frame 283) and flies and scales 3x into the end-card logo, swapped to a real S4/Logo on frame 346 by default.
Graphic: trim-path accents: the wheel ring, the dimension line with ticks, the hand-drawn loop around '10%', the bowl arc drawn centre-out, and the arrow drawn shaft first.
Graphic: CTA numbers: a 640 × 120 pill with a 40 px label readable for 2.8 s, an 8 % punch with settle, a 50 px ripple, and arrow nudges at 13.267 and 13.8.
Graphic: name + price for every collection item, built as a list that persists so each entry is readable for at least 1.06 s.
Camera: the velocity-matched push-through, the ad's only camera move. S2 dives 1 → 2.6 into the vase belly (5.6–6.0) with blur up to 18. S3 arrives at 0.82 → 1 on expo-out while the blur clears.
Camera: lag-and-settle follow-through on secondaries: the wheel ring, the collection pointer dot that trails each cut by 3 frames, and '32 cm'.
Camera: 8 px blur on the first frames of big type rises; the soft 'slow' curve (cubic:0.25,0.6,0.15,1) on the 'Slow' tracking collapse.
Camera: a centred 'Moku' wordmark on frame 0 whose tracking locks on beat 1.8 (the centre brand moment).
Camera: the breath (10.4–10.9) placed directly before the end card; the offer restated on the end card above the CTA; plain clip frames for every mask.
Fixes from the judges: no whip, no panel burst and no grain. Exactly two devices between 6 and 9 s. No Inter text below 28 px. All text between y 304 and y 1500. The image slit starts at 240 px.

Fixes from the judges (build): no reliance on corner-radius clamping (radius keyed as W/2 or H/2); round caps guarded; no TRANSLATION on any auto-layout child; every animated row has a FIXED width; bloom circles Ø 3000; blur on every edge faster than 150 px/frame, peak ≤ 18; and a TRANSLATION_X fallback for every STACK_SPACING track.
